C310.why: HF input cap across VIN pin 1 and GND pin 8, which sit together at the east end; both pads 0.67 mm from their pins, loop 1.94 mm² (TI TPS62850x-Q1 SLUSDM0N §9.5.1 and Figure 9-61)

C311.why: 10 µF input cap beside C310 across the same pins, 2.15 mm out (TI TPS62850x-Q1 SLUSDM0N §9.5.1 and Figure 9-61: 10 µF input, as close as possible)

L302.why: 0.56 µH on SW pin 7, SW pad 1.97 mm from the pin, north of the chip so the SW copper is short (TI TPS62850x-Q1 SLUSDM0N §9.5.1 and Figure 9-61)

R304.why: FB divider top (76.8k) on the west side, 0.6 mm from FB pin 5 and 1.4 mm from the switch node (TI TPS62850x-Q1 SLUSDM0N §9.5.1 and Figure 9-61: FB resistors close to the IC, away from SW)

R305.why: FB divider bottom (51k), 0.55 mm from FB pin 5, 1.1 mm from the switch node; as R304

C319.why: 10 pF feed-forward across R304, 0.7 mm from FB pin 5 (TI Table 9-2)

C314.why: 22 µF output cap on L302's output, its ground near C310's

C317.why: 100 nF HF output cap in the output row

anchor_why: U303 is a TPS628502QDRLRQ1 on 3V3_MAIN since DEC-026; the cell was recomposed round its SOT-583 pinout (the LMQ66430 cell was approved in D06)
